summary_en: Final dividend for FY5/26 increased by 3 yen to 70 yen/share from 67 yen/share announced on 18 May 2026. Prior-year final dividend was 60 yen/share (52 yen ordinary + 8 yen anniversary commemoration). Subject to approval at regular shareholder meeting in August 2026.
title_en: Notice of revision to dividend forecast (dividend increase)
translation_en_brief: Daiko Tsusan announced on 14 July 2026 a revision to its FY5/26 (year ending 31 May 2026) final dividend forecast. The board resolved to increase the dividend from 67 yen per share (announced 18 May 2026) to 70 yen per share—a 3 yen hike. This compares to the prior year's (FY5/25) final dividend of 60 yen per share, which comprised 52 yen ordinary dividend and 8 yen anniversary commemorative dividend. The company cited its policy of balanced capital allocation: returning profits to shareholders while maintaining prudent reserves for working capital and future business development. The revised dividend is subject to approval at the regular shareholders meeting scheduled for August 2026.
